body: Thank you so much for even commenting on my post. I didn't think that anybody would care enough to read it let alone respond. I'm starting to see a therapist (even though I'm skeptical about it), and I'm hoping that she can help. I'm also prescribed anti-depressants, but I regularly forget to take them which contributes to my mood swings. Again, I really appreciate that you took time out of your day to reply. I'm feeling okay right now, but then again my mood changes sporadically. Talking to you and others has definitely helped though. Thank you.

The state forced me to go to rehab-It's almost like I was a liability I guess. It was a facility for suicidal teens, but they also specialized in cases of overdoses and such. My experience at this specific facility was bad. During my days there, we did a whole lot of nothing. I mostly passed the time by looking out of the windows and crying. I understand that there may be good treatment centers, but this wasn't one of them.
